releaseNotesKm: ទិដ្ឋភាពឆ្នាំថ្មី៖ ១២ ខែក្នុងអេក្រង់តែមួយ ជាមួយថ្ងៃពិត បុណ្យជាតិ និងចំណុចបង្ហាញថ្ងៃមមាញឹក។ ចុចខែដើម្បីបើកខែ ចុចថ្ងៃដើម្បីបើកថ្ងៃ។ ចុចឱ្យយូរលើថ្ងៃណាមួយ ដើម្បីបន្ថែមព្រឹត្តិការណ៍ ឬកិច្ចការ។ ជួសជុល៖ ការចុចពីរដងលើថ្ងៃមិនដំណើរការ។
releaseNotesEn: A year view - twelve real month grids on one screen, with holidays, today's disc and a dot on every day that has something on it, so you can see the shape of the year and still tap a date in it. Tap a month to open it, a day to open that day. Long-press any date for its actions: add an event, add a task, open the day. Fixed: double-tapping a date in the month grid did nothing at all - the handler was passed in and never wired up.
